# Mboka

> Mboka is a business banking and payments platform for companies in Africa and the Global South. It provides local business bank accounts in 18+ currencies, USD virtual cards for business spend, collections and payouts across 20+ countries, and USDT/USDC stablecoin holding and settlement — all in one platform. Mboka is a product of ElementPay.

## Key pages

- [Mboka](https://mboka.finance): Overview of global banking, virtual cards, payments, and stablecoin capabilities for African businesses.

## Capabilities

- Global banking: local bank accounts in 18+ currencies, each in the business's own name, with real account details (not pooled accounts).
- Virtual cards: USD virtual cards for online business spend (ads, SaaS, suppliers), with per-card limits and instant freeze.
- Payments: collections from mobile money/bank/card/stablecoins, payouts to mobile money and banks in 20+ countries, and bulk payouts from a single file.
- Stablecoins: hold, send, and receive USDT and USDC; cash out to local currency or buy with USD.
- Reports & invoices: branded invoices payable in any currency, with volume reporting.
- API: programmatic access to payouts and other capabilities, with webhooks for status changes.

## Markets served

Live payout corridors include Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana, Tanzania, South Africa, Egypt, and more, alongside USD, GBP, and EUR accounts.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Exchange rates shown on the public site are indicative, not locked quotes.
- The authenticated dashboard (/dashboard) requires an account and is not part of the public marketing content.
